'''Nova''' is a map for quite fast paced gameplay with 3 floor levels. It has a centred [[Red Armor]] and two more additional [[Yellow Armor]] on each side of the map. It has a rather bright textured option with some variation to the texturing dependent on areas of the map to ease navigation a bit. The map is quite low on ammunition with 15 rockets and 12 cells to prevent too much spamming.

Location file is made by {{player|flintheart|flag=se}}
